strongest_fixed_policy_selection: one of COMPUTE_FIRST / INFORMATION_FIRST / ACCESSIBILITY_FIRST / RESTART_REFORMULATE_FIRST is selected on development data before protected primary/replication; no protected reselection
primary_success_contrast: candidate final task success - strongest fixed final task success

uncertainty.method: deterministic SHA-256 counter-stream nonparametric bootstrap of paired success differences

charged_regret: per task, charged cost of selected action minus the causal-gold minimum charged cost; for METHOD/CANNOT_CHECK where no intervention succeeds, regret is still the charged attempted intervention cost relative to zero successful-intervention cost only if the frozen campaign accounting defines it prospectively; otherwise the task must carry CANNOT_CHECK_REGRET and the broad regret gate cannot pass
false_compute_escalation: selected action == COMPUTATION while causal gold cause != COMPUTATION

pass_gate_all_required.charged_regret: mean candidate charged regret <= 0.5 * mean strongest-fixed charged regret
pass_gate_all_required.false_compute: candidate false-compute-escalation rate < compute-first false-compute-escalation rate
pass_gate_all_required.domain_direction: positive mean success difference in >=3 of the frozen >=4 scientific domains
pass_gate_all_required.leakage: every task passed the frozen causal-gold leakage contract; any violation invalidates the study

negative_result_policy: No cause-class, fixed baseline, cost rule, domain denominator, false-compute definition or task denominator may change after protected outcomes. A null, harmful, heterogeneous, replication-negative, leakage-invalid or CANNOT_CHECK result is retained.
